mapper.select:
SELECT p.* from scc_npm_sou_plan p join scc_npm_sou_plan a on a.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID and a.PLAN_TYPE='ACTUAL' where p.PLAN_TYPE='PLAN'
and p.PUBLISH_TIME >= #{publishTime} and a.PUBLISH_TIME is NULL
and p.TECH_OPEN_TIME is not NULL and a.TECH_OPEN_TIME is NULL and a.PUBLISH_TIME is not NULL and (DATEDIFF(NOW(),a.PUBLISH_TIME) - DATEDIFF(p.TECH_OPEN_TIME,p.PUBLISH_TIME)) IN (1,3)
and p.PRICE_OPEN_TIME is not NULL and a.PRICE_OPEN_TIME is NULL and a.PUBLISH_TIME is not NULL and (DATEDIFF(NOW(),a.PUBLISH_TIME) - DATEDIFF(p.PRICE_OPEN_TIME,p.PUBLISH_TIME)) IN (1,3)
and p.TECH_EVALUATION_TIME is not NULL and a.TECH_EVALUATION_TIME is NULL and a.TECH_OPEN_TIME is not NULL and (DATEDIFF(NOW(),a.TECH_OPEN_TIME) - DATEDIFF(p.TECH_EVALUATION_TIME,p.TECH_OPEN_TIME)) IN (1,3)
and p.SUM_REPORT_TIME is not null and a.SUM_REPORT_TIME is NULL and (a.TECH_EVALUATION_TIME is not NULL OR a.PRICE_OPEN_TIME IS NOT NULL) and (DATEDIFF(NOW(),IFNULL(a.TECH_EVALUATION_TIME,a.PRICE_OPEN_TIME)) - DATEDIFF(p.SUM_REPORT_TIME,IFNULL(p.TECH_EVALUATION_TIME,p.PRICE_OPEN_TIME))) IN (1,3)
and p.PICKETAGE_TIME is not null and a.PICKETAGE_TIME is NULL and a.SUM_REPORT_TIME is not null and (DATEDIFF(NOW(),a.SUM_REPORT_TIME) - DATEDIFF(p.PICKETAGE_TIME,p.SUM_REPORT_TIME)) IN (1,3)
and p.PUBLISH_WIN_LOSS_TIME is not null and a.PUBLISH_WIN_LOSS_TIME is NULL and a.PICKETAGE_TIME is not null and (DATEDIFF(NOW(),a.PICKETAGE_TIME) - DATEDIFF(p.PUBLISH_WIN_LOSS_TIME,p.PICKETAGE_TIME)) IN (1,3)
